effect_entries.effect: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent.  Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.  This ability cannot be copied or replaced.  This ability only takes effect for Greninja.
effect_entries.short_effect: Transforms this Pokémon into Ash-Greninja after fainting an opponent.  Water Shuriken's power is 20 and always hits three times.

flavor_text_entries.flavor_text: En battant un ennemi, ce Pokémon renforce ses liens avec son Dresseur. Il prend alors sa Forme Sacha et ses Sheauriken gagnent en puissance.
Defeating an opposing Pokémon strengthens the Pokémon’s bond with its Trainer, and it becomes Ash-Greninja. Water Shuriken gets more powerful.
